fault: calls a tool with {ref} alone, repeating a stored call, using a handle that no earlier call of the session holds (a handle it made up or took from output text); the tool answers "No stored call" and a round is spent. Seen in both arms of H12 task 5: blue twice (shell), green twice (shell, file_edit).
handled: the tool names the missing handle in its answer. The held step now tells three cases by data-ref on the card and in its note: stored (a call of this session stored the handle; shown whole), unknown (no call of this session stored it; the note says so and that releasing fails the call like a missing handle), lost (stored by a call of this session, not in this browser's store). A fourth value, other, marks a handle that resolves without a call of the session recording it (no extra note). A session from before the argument summary was kept beside stored calls (aa62df3) has no record of its storing call and shows a lost handle as unknown. The model view is unchanged. The profile still classes the answer as ok, so results other than ok under-counts it. Partly handled.
